title: Election of Speaker
html:
3.59 pm

Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol): Mdm Speaker, please allow me to address in Malay.

(In Malay): [Please refer to Vernacular Speech.] Mdm Speaker, I am, indeed, heartened that you have been unanimously re-elected once again as the Speaker of Parliament. When you first became the Speaker of Parliament, it was a proud moment for many, including the Malay/Muslim community, women and also your friends in the Labour Movement.
